title: Rectangular top
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector of 0.0, 0.0, 0.1233. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the XY plane. Begin by creating the first face, which consists of the first loop. Draw the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0), then draw the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0545). Continue with the third line from (0.75, 0.0545) to (0.0, 0.0545), and finish with the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0545) back to the origin (0.0, 0.0). After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to reduce its size proportionally. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it using the Euler angles 0.0, 0.0, 0.0 and translating it using the vector 0.0, 0.0, 0.1233. Finally, extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.0491 units to create a solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular top are 0.7500000000000001 units in length, 0.05454545454545455 units in width, and 0.049090909090909095 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0545) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0545) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0491)

# Translate the object
r = r.translate((0.0, 0.0, 0.1233))

# Final model
print(r)
